answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the haven binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 6 separate vaults requires a separate funded copper account and a separate escrow deposit for each, as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The zenith explorer reveals the whole merge tree. Honest users pay that once, farms 33 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
